title: Dnevni tržišni osvrt — prethodna raspoloživa sesija
title_en: Daily Market Brief — Previous Available Session
headline: Pregled posljednje raspoložive tržišne sesije temeljen na javno dostupnim podatcima o indeksima, digitalnoj imovini i stablecoin odstupanjima.
headline_en: Review of the latest available market session based on publicly available index, digital-asset and stablecoin-deviation observations.
summary: Promatrani burzovni indeksi zabilježili su široko pozitivan raspored kretanja. Najjaču promjenu pokazao je Nikkei 225 (+5.79%), dok je najslabiji rezultat imao S&P 500 (+1.57%).
U promatranom skupu digitalne imovine ETH je imao najizraženiju 24-satnu promjenu (-1.14%), dok je BTC zabilježio najslabije kretanje (-1.60%).
Najveće promatrano stablecoin odstupanje od referentne valute zabilježeno je kod FDUSD (-0.2994%). To je tržišno opažanje, a ne procjena rezervi ili otkupivosti.
Bitcoin: -1.57% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi; zlato: -1.11% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi; Brent nafta: -13.01% u sedmodnevnoj usporedbi.
summary_en: Observed equity indices showed a broadly positive distribution of moves. Nikkei 225 recorded the strongest change (+5.79%), while S&P 500 was weakest (+1.57%).
Within the observed digital-asset set, ETH recorded the strongest 24-hour move (-1.14%), while BTC was weakest (-1.60%).
The largest observed stablecoin deviation from its reference currency was recorded for FDUSD (-0.2994%). This is a market observation, not a reserve or redemption assessment.
Bitcoin: -1.57% over the seven-day comparison; gold: -1.11% over the seven-day comparison; Brent crude: -13.01% over the seven-day comparison.
risk_note: Informativni analitički prikaz temeljen na javno dostupnim podatcima; nije investicijski savjet, preporuka ulaganja niti jamstvo budućeg kretanja.
risk_note_en: Informational analytical display based on publicly available data; it is not investment advice, an investment recommendation or a guarantee of future performance.
